recommendations.text: The table of contents should call the auditor's report the Independent Auditor's Report.
The company was founded in 2019, please fill that in.
Throughout the executive summary, replace [NAME OF COMPANY] with Northwind Group.
The placeholder should ask for an independent auditor's report, not an accountant or auditor's report.
Rename PREPARED BY to AUTHOR and APPROVED BY to REVIEWER; leave TITLE and DATE alone.
We report Turnover, not Net Sales. Change it everywhere in the statement, including the total line.
Remove the Amortization of Purchased Intangible Assets row from the income statement.
In the first disclaimer sentence drop 'by Smartsheet', so it just says information provided on the website.
Add a reference: Annual accounts 2023, Companies House.
In the abstract, say electronic payments instead of online payments.
The contact email should be satoshi@example.org.
Write double spending without the hyphen throughout the abstract.
The title should say Always-On instead of Highly Available.
The platform runs on hundreds of thousands of servers, not tens of thousands.
Only in the abstract, call the design third-generation instead of second-generation. Keep the title as it is.
Paul Syverson's affiliation should read U.S. Naval Research Laboratory.
The NYU address should be 60 Fifth Avenue instead of 715 Broadway, 7th Floor.
The special meeting starts at 7:00 p.m., not 7:30 a.m.
The Superintendent's Office extension is now 61300.
Make the welcome paragraph friendlier.
Public comments are now limited to two minutes per speaker. Update both places that say three minutes.
Change the closed session time limit to 20 minutes.
The taxpayer moved: the city line should be Shelbyville, IL 62565.
This return is for 2008. Change the tax year printed in the form header from 2007 to 2008.
The docket number should be FAA-2020-0687.
Correct the page number B-1191 to B-1192.
Change the first amount in the table to 1,000.00.
Rename the heading Titre to Titre principal.
Dans le tableau, « Linge 2 » est une faute de frappe : il faut écrire « Ligne 2 ».
Maxim Integrated Products' notice date should be 06/23/2015.
For the Maxim Integrated Product notice received on 07/10/2015 (20 employees), the notice date should be 07/02/2015.
The company is now called McGraw Hill.
For the Ministry of Agriculture, the plan revenue figure should be 28130.50.
The Department of Agriculture and Cooperation has been renamed the Department of Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers Welfare.
The argument started at 1:10 p.m., not 1:01 p.m.
Remove the stray full stop after the respondent's name in the caption.
Reviews of the fee schedule should happen every quarter.
Raise the late payment fee to $30.
